apps.name: Fluxa

apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- feat(player): back arrow on the chapters panel (`0d0b14bb`)
- fix(player): skip black frames when loading chapter thumbnails (`06d3ad71`)
- fix(player): take chapter thumbnails one second in (`4b77c467`)
- fix(player): load chapter thumbnails when the chapters panel opens (`54b6ff7a`)
- fix(player): make the chapter name clickable in the desktop control row (`0717131b`)
- fix(player): show torrent progress while loading when the link only appears in the stream url (`0187520f`)
- feat(player): back arrow on the subtitle style panel (`926d07b3`)
- fix(player): larger subtitle chips and no language heading under the back icon (`dc0095ba`)

- fix(player): expand the minimized player when its title is played again (`d4fe7df5`)
- fix(watch): hide the watch together modal while a player is minimized (`d95461da`)
- fix(player): don't reveal controls when the pointer is over the skip button (`c9ed6ea9`)
- fix(player): keep controls hidden after skipping intro, recap or outro (`795598eb`)
- fix(android): relayout video surface when returning from picture-in-picture (`42c05733`)
